name: Vitals Records Table
description: Displays a full server-side paginated and filterable table of all vitals records for a given patient, with export support.

when_to_use: User wants to browse, search, or export a tabular list of vitals records
User wants to see all vitals fields in a table format
User wants to filter vitals by date range
User wants to export vitals data
when_not_to_use: User wants charts or trend visualisations — use view_vitals_dashboard instead
User wants to record or create new vitals entries

introduction: Here are the vitals records for this patient.
